title: Unique Jamaican Cumin Ground Delight Bao
description: Nutty and springy, this nostalgic Jamaican dish features the bold flavor of ground cumin, cooked in a traditional ttukbaegi earthenware pot. Paleo-friendly and perfect for a quick dinner or snack.

ingredients.name: ground beef
ingredients.notes: lean and grass-fed for optimal nutrition

ingredients.name: onion
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced and caramelized for sweetness

ingredients.name: garlic
ingredients.notes: minced and sautéed for depth of flavor

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: coarse, Himalayan pink for added mineral content

ingredients.name: bacon
ingredients.notes: crispy and crumbled for added texture

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: gluten-free alternative for the paleo diet

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: filtered and cold for optimal hydration

ingredients.name: bacon fat
ingredients.notes: reserved and reused for added flavor

instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Add the bacon to the pot and cook until crispy, about 6 minutes.
Remove the bacon from the pot and set aside, leaving the fat behind.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until caramelized, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the ground cumin to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the ground beef to the pot, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the salt and black pepper to the pot, stirring to combine.
Add the flour to the pot, stirring to combine.
Gradually add the water to the pot, stirring constantly to avoid lumps.
Return the crispy bacon to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the beef is cooked through.
Serve the Unique Jamaican Cumin Ground Delight Bao hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro and scallions if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F.
